name: crypto-sentiment-app
description: AI-powered crypto sentiment analysis & investment-likelihood signals (React + Node.js)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run demo" "npm --prefix client run dev"
